data.title: Beach Hills Villas
data.about:
Experience nature and a luxury lifestyle melding perfectly at Al Zorah Beach Hills Villas! This opulent complex, tucked away from the bustle of the city, is set within the stunning suburb of Al Zorah. 

Two types of 4 bedroom villas in Beach Hills, including simplex villas and duplex villas, feature modern architecture and a cohesive living environment. Each residence has a private pool, lush gardens, and a courtyard with a serene backdrop of the sea. Situated near the shoreline, the single-story homes reimagine open-plan living. Thanks to the high-tech interior design, the kitchen and dining area are multi-functional and can either become part of the living area for family gatherings or shut off for privacy. 

Boasting a sprawling area of 5.4 million square meters, Al Zorah is located just minutes away from Dubai and Sharjah. The prominent waterfront development showcases a terrain of unspoiled beaches, thriving mangroves, and verdant forests.

characteristics_module.title: Barefoot luxury is the essence of this community, redefining sophisticated living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Al Zorah Beach Hills Villas offer exclusive amenities, including a private swimming pool and multi-functional spaces.
  • Surrounded by lush gardens and a secluded landscaped courtyard, creating a tranquil environment.
  • The villas feature 4 bedrooms and a single-floor layout with expansive kitchens.
  • Thoughtful design ensures proximity to the shoreline and privacy with spacious private residences.
  • Enjoy versatile outdoor spaces that complement the overall harmonious living experience.
  • Residents can take panoramic sea views from their homes with private beach access.
  • There are three distinct entry points: the primary guest entrance, a secondary family entrance, and a service entrance.

location_tile.title: Al Zorah: Where Elegance Meets Coastal Tranquility
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Al Zorah Beach Hills Villas is the perfect blend of elegance and leisure. It is located in Al Zorah, a beachside haven. Nestled in the heart of Ajman, Al Zorah is home to the prestigious Al Zorah Golf Club and the stunning Al Zorah Public Beach. 25 minutes from DXB International Airport, the community provides easy access to family-friendly amenities like hospitals, clinics, and schools. It ensures a harmonious living experience, integrating state-of-the-art amenities, such as wellness and relaxation spaces, with the natural surroundings. 

  • Within Walking Distance - Al Zorah Public Beach
  • 6 mins - The Oberoi Beach Resort
  • 10 mins - UAE Pygmy Zoo
  • 15 mins - Al Bustan
  • 17 mins - City Centre Ajman
  • 30 mins - Sharjah International Airport
